hook.name: PumpHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Gwei Station pools that pairs a launched token (currency1) with a fuel asset (currency0). It charges a fixed trading fee (10–500 bps, set at pool creation) on every swap entirely in the fuel asset, distributing it among a station address, up to three creator wallets, token holders (via an external payouts contract), a buyback-and-burn mechanism, and an optional charity. Liquidity additions are gated to a designated locker address.
